consequence.statement: Envoy logs show more error details on ambient-mode connection failures; no operational impact is stated.

original.statement: Envoy logs for connection failures in ambient mode now show more error details.

decision.reason: [ev-a5a74f4cd759] describes this only as an improvement: Envoy logs show more error details when connections fail in ambient mode. Nothing in it says anything fails, is rejected, stops being honoured, loses access or must be migrated. It also doesn't say the log format changes in a way that would break existing consumers. That makes "none" (informational) the right fit for a diagnostic-only improvement, and it doesn't hide any stated failure.
